_doc: Style spec for tools/blender/nature.py. Footprint/height come from content/props.json; parts are authored in Blender axes (X right, Y back, Z up, front = -Y = glTF +Z) at roughly final size and then fitted (fit: height = uniform scale to PropDef.height; box = per-axis to footprint minus margin and height; [axes] = only those axes). Shapes/texture generators are keyed by id in nature_lib.py.
